title: What’s Worth Productizing?
text_runs: Hone what your clients celebrate to be useful to other clients.
Note: drop in keywords like “colocation” “Data ingestion” “multiuser” “Optimization pipeline”
directives: Note: drop in keywords like “colocation” “Data ingestion” “multiuser” “Optimization pipeline”
speaker_notes:
J
Three signals we've learned to listen for:
Same question, different client. Not just similar projects, the literally same question.
Reusable answer, not reusable input. If the answer changes per project, you can't productize. If the process of getting the answer is what's reusable, you can.
Adjacent client, no salesperson needed. When a peer-referral asks the same thing without you pitching, you have a product.
Visual: three checkboxes. Memorable.
